========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-124194                       
  Outlook: Network Spoofing Flaw        
                                        
  CISA added a zero-interaction flaw to 
  its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities   
  catalog. Remote unauthenticated       
  attackers can spoof network actions to
  compromise target systems without user
  prompts.                              
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-111793                       
  Webtop: Media Transcoder Flaw         
                                        
  A resource transfer vulnerability     
  enables authenticated users to convert
  unauthorized documents and breach     
  boundaries. CISA flags active         
  exploitation, ordering federal patches
  within two weeks.                     
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

SECURITY ADVISORY (3/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-20320                        
  BroadWorks: XXE Data Leak Bug         
                                        
  An unauthenticated remote XXE flaw    
  exposes sensitive server configuration
  files on Cisco BroadWorks. CISA       
  confirmed active exploitation,        
  mandating remediation across federal  
  systems by Nov 24.                    
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu: Yodl Buffer Over-Read         
                                        
  Canonical patched a buffer over-read  
  vulnerability in Yodl. Specially      
  crafted input could cause the document
  pre-parser to crash, triggering       
  denial-of-service conditions on       
  impacted Ubuntu hosts.                
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
